svg.title: Microduck dock base, cut 1
svg.desc: Bit: 6.350 mm (0.250 in) - set this on Origin. Cut types: exterior @ 18.50 mm deep x1, interior @ 18.50 mm deep x1, guide x3. Geometry is the finished part size; Origin applies the bit offset. Colours per notes/shaper-svg.md (Shaper cut type encoding). shaper:cutDepth is a target and over-depth check; set the cut depth on Origin yourself. Material: 3/4 in plywood, thickness 18.00 mm (PLACEHOLDER - NOT MEASURED, do not cut good stock). Outline and tenon slot: through, 18.50 mm deep (thickness + 0.5 mm). Tenon slot reliefs sized for the bit above; a different bit needs a re-run. Blue crosses are guide marks for the cable-clip screws: drill by hand, not cut. Foot outlines are guide marks only (sizes are GUESSES until the duck arrives). Top face is the face you see in this file (the foot marks go on top).
